about_short_description.short_description: Amera is a nursing home offering assisted living services.

product.name: Assisted Living Services
product.description: Provides residential care and support for individuals who need assistance with daily living activities in a nursing home setting.

product.name: Continuing and Palliative Care
product.description: Provides ongoing medical and nursing care for residents recovering from acute health episodes or with incurable diseases requiring symptom management.

product.name: Dementia Care
product.description: Specialized care for residents with dementia, including cognitive and behavioral assessment and support to maintain autonomy.

product.name: Nutritional Support and Dietary Services
product.description: Provides tailored meal planning and nutritional support adapted to residents’ health needs and dietary restrictions.

product.name: Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation
product.description: Offers physiotherapy services to improve residents’ mobility, strength, and coordination, aiding recovery and daily functioning.

product.name: Social and Therapeutic Activities
product.description: Organizes daily activities to promote social interaction, cognitive stimulation, and motor skills among residents.
